reviewScope: Read-only review of the unchanged-pipeline replay output, saved input boundary arrays, diagnostic implementation and receipts. No scientific source, running process or geometry was modified by this review.

reviewedOpenContourEvidence.method: Diagnostic compares undirected coordinate-edge multisets after documented zero-area face exclusion. The diagnostic implementation and these reported results were reviewed; the independent additional computation focused on frozen-coordinate multisets and the added vertex fan.

independentlyRecomputedAddedVertexFan.interpretation: A locally closed six-triangle interior fan; the added vertex is not an open contour vertex. This does not assert that its entire connected component is globally closed.

inference.supportedConclusion: The original check classified every vertex lying exactly on a slab plane as a frozen boundary vertex. One added interior-fan vertex increased that count; no original frozen coordinate multiplicity or reported open contour edge was lost.
inference.roundingMechanism: Consistent with a strict double-precision interior candidate rounding onto the plane when exported to float32. This mechanism is inferred, because pre-cast double coordinates were not recorded.
inference.originalAttemptCaveat: The first failed attempt did not retain a numerical payload hash. This is an unchanged-pipeline replay output, not a demonstrated byte-for-byte recovery of that first attempt.

conditions: Preserve the captured replay NPZ bytes and their recorded SHA-256.
Retain the original failed assertion and add a separately hashed validation-recovery receipt; do not claim the original count assertion passed.
Weld only genuine open contours; preserve the added closed interior fan instead of snapping it to another component.
Keep the other 30 accepted slab payloads and receipts unchanged.
Bind recovery validation and the new seam-only welder to final processing provenance, then require the complete seam and delivered-asset validation gates.
recoveryAssessment.notEstablished: This review does not establish full-organ topology, anatomical accuracy, final encoding quality, browser performance or publication readiness.
